releases.notes:
Minecraft instance detection and launcher reliability patch.

Fixes:
- Detects official, Modrinth, Prism Launcher, and MultiMC instances containing `mods/pi-minecraft-*.jar`
- Setup explicitly asks users to install the mod JAR before instance detection
- Presents all matching instances plus a manual folder picker
- Validates manually selected instances contain the Pi mod
- Safely transports workspace and instance paths containing spaces across Windows and WSL
- Adds a noninteractive PowerShell 5.1 detector fixture to release packaging

Download and extract `pi-minecraft-v0.1.3.zip`, install the bundled JAR into your chosen instance, then run `Start Pi Minecraft.cmd`.

releases.notes:
Launcher polish release focused on a clean first-run experience.

Highlights:
- Obvious root-level `Start Pi Minecraft.cmd` and `Configure Pi Minecraft.cmd` entrypoints
- Interactive first-run setup with remembered settings
- WSL distribution selection
- Folder pickers for both Windows and WSL-native workspaces
- Workspace and Minecraft instance validation
- Clear one-time dependency installation notice
- Production installs omit development dependencies and use bundled compiled bridge output
- Friendly missing-dependency and already-running bridge diagnostics
- Preserves bridge authentication and remembered Pi sessions
- Verified against downloaded-file Windows security markers

Download and extract `pi-minecraft-v0.1.2.zip`, install the bundled JAR in your Fabric mods folder, then double-click `Start Pi Minecraft.cmd`.

releases.notes:
Patch release fixing first-run launcher documentation for downloaded bundles.

Fixes:
- All player-facing commands now use `launch-pi-bridge.cmd`, which applies a process-scoped PowerShell execution-policy bypass.
- Verified the CMD launcher works when both downloaded launcher files carry the Windows Internet Zone marker.
- Removed developer-specific user paths from public documentation.
- Quick-start download link now always points to the latest release.

Download `pi-minecraft-v0.1.1.zip`, extract the complete bundle, and double-click `scripts\launch-pi-bridge.cmd`. Do not invoke the `.ps1` file directly.

releases.notes:
First MVP release of Pi for Minecraft.

Highlights:
- Native client-side Fabric conversation UI for Minecraft 26.2
- Streaming Pi sessions with reconnectable authenticated Windows/WSL bridge
- Markdown, fenced code, selectable text, tool lifecycle cards, and native Edit diffs
- Specialized Bash, Read, Edit, Write, and web research cards
- Windows-to-WSL bridge launcher with dependency checks and automatic builds

Download `pi-minecraft-v0.1.0.zip` for the complete launcher bundle, or the standalone JAR for an existing bridge checkout. See `INSTALL.md` inside the bundle.

Requires Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Java 25, and WSL with Node.js 24+, npm, and Pi.
